domain-information: A Customer browses the catalog and compares skincare product models
A Customer purchases a skincare product
A Customer leaves a review of their purchased skincare product
A Sales Associate guides customers through product options and explains key features to help them make informed choices
A Sales Associate processes purchases and coordinates deliveries to ensure customers receive their skincare products promptly
A Product Specialist evaluates new skincare product models and recommends additions to the catalog based on trends and customer feedback
A Product Specialist writes detailed descriptions and usage tips to help customers understand each model
An Inventory Manager monitors stock levels in the warehouse system and reorders popular skincare products to prevent shortages
An Inventory Manager updates the warehouse system when shipments arrive to keep availability accurate
An Inventory Manager tracks returns and restocks skincare products or accessories to maintain proper inventory
